# Bundled nlohmann/json

This directory contains the single-header distribution of CLIUtils/CLI11 2.7.2,
pinned from the upstream `v2.7.2` release. It is used only when CMake cannot find
a suitable system `CLI11` package or when
`CXX_MODGRAPH_USE_BUNDLED_CLI11=ON` is selected.

The upstream project is licensed under the 3-clause BSD license license; see
`LICENSE.3BSD`.
